ui.heroTitle: A vivid world from one small seed.
ui.heroDescription: Generate a geography atlas, explore its biomes, and inspect the climate beneath every cell. The world streams in chunk by chunk, stores preferences locally, and loads no engine or map resources until you enter. Game mode keeps the camera centered on the explorer; dev mode unlocks survey controls.
ui.standaloneDescription: Stream an infinite local world. Nothing leaves your browser.
ui.placeholder: PixiJS, the generation worker, content definitions, and terrain resources are waiting behind the button.
ui.standalonePlaceholder: The renderer, worker, and world data load on demand.
ui.devModeEnabled: Battle shadow, fast move, shift-click teleport, free camera, zoom, and equipment testing are enabled.
ui.footerControls: WASD or arrows walk. Hold Shift to run. E or Space acts. In game mode, the camera follows the explorer and zoom stays locked. The minimap fills as you discover the world.
ui.footerControlsStandalone: WASD or arrows walk. Hold Shift to run. E or Space acts. Drag pans the camera. Scroll zooms. The minimap fills as you discover chunks.
ui.footerControlsDev: In dev mode, drag pans the camera, scroll zooms, press F for fast move, shift-click teleports, and the in-game panel exposes equipment overrides.
ui.gameStartError: The world could not be started.
ui.saveDescription: Manage snapshots stored only in this browser. Autosaves, manual saves, and imports stay separate.

devPanel.heading: Dev Mode
devPanel.tabMovementHint: Movement cheats, fog reveal, fast travel, and traversal debug toggles.
devPanel.tabWorldHint: World visibility, minimap, day-night, and light tuning controls.
devPanel.tabGearHint: Swap explorer equipment and weapon slots for quick testing.
devPanel.entityDiagnosticsDetail: Active {active}; retained {retained}; owner links {owners}; despawned {despawned}; conflicts {conflicts}.

devPanel.teleportBlocked: Cannot teleport to ({x}, {y}); terrain is blocked.

characterPanel.CharacterEquipmentHint: Inspect the generated loadout and the field item catalog. Inventory ownership and stacks arrive with the equipment module.

journal.JournalTabsHint: Q / E or arrow keys to move between sections
journal.JournalSaveLead: Leave a deliberate marker in the world before you step back into the fog.
journal.JournalSaveFailed: The record could not be written. Try again.
journal.JournalSaveUnavailable: Saving is unavailable until the world snapshot is ready.
journal.JournalGuideLead: A short field lesson for moving, acting, reading the map, and opening the records that travel with you.
journal.JournalGuideNote: The Chronicle pauses movement while open. Close it with Esc or M whenever you want the map back.
journal.JournalGuideMoveBody: WASD or the arrow keys move the Wayfinder through passable terrain.
journal.JournalGuideRunBody: Hold Shift while moving to run. The field map and status HUD stay available as you travel.
journal.JournalGuideActBody: Press E or Space to use the configured action on yourself or inspect a nearby landmark.
journal.JournalGuideSettingsBody: Press Esc to open Settings when you are traveling. Close the active surface with Esc when it is already open.
journal.JournalGuideCharacterBody: Press C to open the Wayfinder dossier for abilities, equipment, skills, and field systems.
journal.JournalGuideItemsBody: Press I to open the ability ledger, then use the dossier rail to reach equipment and item records.
journal.JournalGuideMapBody: Press M to open the field map. The map remains visible around the Chronicle on wider screens.
journal.JournalGuideManualsBody: Terrain entries and wildlife references describe the catalog. Encounter history will arrive with the creature system.
journal.JournalTerrainLead: A readable index of the terrain catalog currently shaping the world, with movement, roads, ecology, and field conditions.
journal.JournalTerrainEmpty: No terrain definitions are available for this world.
journal.JournalTerrainSourceNote: Detailed material rules are being connected to the content-pack runtime; these entries use the authoritative biome catalog for now.
journal.JournalBestiaryLead: Keep the ink honest: this page separates creature definitions from ecological references until encounters can be recorded.
journal.JournalEncounterLedgerUnavailable: Creatures will appear here after observation and encounter systems can persist first-seen records. Nothing below is marked as encountered.
journal.JournalBestiaryEmpty: No creature references are available for this world.
journal.JournalMapLead: A compact survey of where the Wayfinder stands and what the loaded field has revealed so far.
journal.JournalNoLandmarks: No named landmarks are loaded nearby yet.
journal.JournalSettingsLead: Keep the Chronicle light enough that the world can remain the main screen.
journal.JournalControlsValue: Esc Settings · M Map · I Abilities / items
journal.JournalSystemsNote: Language, theme, and save transfer remain managed by the outer launcher until their in-world persistence contracts are ready.
